repo_notes.content: This is the Odoo 20.0 community repository (odoo/release.py: version_info = (20, 0, 0, FINAL), Python 3.12-3.14, LGPL-3). It has two halves: the framework in odoo/ (ORM, HTTP layer, module loader, CLI, services, tools, test framework, plus the core 'base' module in odoo/addons/base) and roughly 640 business/feature modules in addons/. Documentation should explain the framework first and in depth, then show how business apps are built on top of it. Always ground explanations in concrete file paths and class names.
repo_notes.author: Repo maintainer

repo_notes.content: The ORM lives in odoo/orm/ (models.py, model_classes.py, fields*.py, environments.py, registry.py, cache.py, domains.py, query.py, decorators.py, commands.py). odoo/models, odoo/fields and odoo/api are thin re-export packages over odoo/orm - describe the real implementation in odoo/orm, not the facades.
repo_notes.author: Repo maintainer

repo_notes.content: The web client is an Owl-based SPA in addons/web/static/src (core/, views/, model/, search/, webclient/, public/). Owl itself is vendored in addons/web/static/lib/owl, and the codebase is mid-migration from Owl 2 to Owl 3: addons/web/static/src/owl2/owl3_compatibility_layer.js and odoo/upgrade_code/owl3-migration.py are the key artifacts. JS tests use the in-house Hoot framework (addons/web/static/lib/hoot, hoot-dom) with tests under each module's static/tests.
repo_notes.author: Repo maintainer

repo_notes.content: Addons follow naming families that should be treated as groups rather than documented one by one: l10n_* (~229 country localizations), website_* (~52), pos_* (~45), sale_* (~29), payment_* (~24 provider integrations), hr_*, project_*, account_*, mrp_*, stock_*, spreadsheet_*, test_* (test-only modules). Bridge modules like sale_stock or project_mrp_account exist only to glue two apps together; mention the pattern, do not give each its own section.
repo_notes.author: Repo maintainer

repo_notes.content: The skills/ directory at the repo root contains agent Skills (odoo-guidelines, odoo-review, odoo-security, odoo-web-guidelines) that encode Odoo's official coding, review and security conventions. Use them as an authoritative source for conventions when describing how code in this repo should be written. Ignore .venv/, __pycache__/, the massive .weblate.json and i18n/*.po translation files - they carry no architectural information.
repo_notes.author: Repo maintainer

pages.title: Odoo Overview
pages.purpose: High-level map of the repository: the odoo/ framework vs. addons/ apps, odoo-bin entry point, how a request flows from HTTP to ORM to PostgreSQL and back to the Owl web client, and how modules compose into a full ERP. Include a top-level architecture diagram.

pages.title: Server Runtime, CLI and Configuration
pages.purpose: Document odoo-bin and odoo/cli (server, shell, scaffold, db, module, neutralize, obfuscate, i18n, upgrade_code commands), configuration parsing in odoo/tools/config.py, and the server modes in odoo/service/server.py (threaded, prefork workers, gevent/longpolling, cron workers). Briefly cover packaging and deployment assets in setup/ (docker, rpm, win32, sandboxing, odoo-wsgi.example.py) and debian/.

pages.title: ORM Framework
pages.purpose: Overview of the object-relational mapper in odoo/orm: recordsets, the Model/TransientModel/AbstractModel hierarchy, how model classes are assembled per registry, and how reads/writes are batched and flushed to PostgreSQL.

pages.title: Models and Inheritance
pages.purpose: Document odoo/orm/models.py, model_classes.py, models_transient.py and models_cached.py: _name/_inherit/_inherits semantics (classical, prototype and delegation inheritance), CRUD methods (create, read, write, unlink, search, web_read/web_search_read), name_search/rec_names_search, and SQL constraints/indexes via table_objects.py.

pages.title: Fields, Computes and Constraints
pages.purpose: Document the field type system across odoo/orm/fields*.py (numeric, textual, temporal, selection, relational, reference, binary, properties, misc), x2many write commands in commands.py, and the decorators in decorators.py (api.depends, api.onchange, api.constrains, api.model, api.ondelete). Explain stored vs. non-stored computes, inverse/search methods, related fields and company-dependent fields.

pages.title: Environment, Registry and Caching
pages.purpose: Document odoo/orm/environments.py (Environment, context, sudo/with_user/with_company), registry.py and odoo/modules/registry (per-database model registry, signaling between workers), the record cache in cache.py, field invalidation/recompute triggers, and tools/cache (ormcache decorators).

pages.title: Domains, Queries and SQL
pages.purpose: Document domain parsing and optimization in odoo/orm/domains.py, the Query builder in query.py, the SQL wrapper types in odoo/tools/sql.py, and cursor/connection pooling in odoo/sql_db.py. Explain how search domains become SQL including joins over many2one/x2many and access-rule injection.

pages.title: Module System and Data Loading
pages.purpose: Document how addons are discovered and installed: __manifest__.py keys, dependency graph in odoo/modules/module_graph.py, loading order in loading.py, module state in module.py/ir_module.py, XML/CSV data import in odoo/tools/convert.py validated by odoo/import_xml.rng, noupdate records, demo data, and pre/post/end migration scripts in odoo/modules/migration.py.

pages.title: Upgrade and Code Migration Tooling
pages.purpose: Document odoo/upgrade_code/ scripts (e.g. tree-to-list, sql-constraint, route-jsonrpc, t-call, ir-access, owl3-migration) and the 'odoo-bin upgrade_code' command in odoo/cli/upgrade_code.py, plus odoo/upgrade. Explain how these scripts rewrite Python/XML/JS source between versions and how to write a new one.

pages.title: HTTP Layer and Routing
pages.purpose: Document odoo/http (router.py, routing_map.py, dispatcher.py, requestlib.py, response.py, session.py, stream.py, retrying.py, server.py): the @route decorator, http vs. json/jsonrpc route types, auth modes (user, public, none, bearer), session handling, request retry on serialization failure, and how ir.http (odoo/addons/base/models/ir_http.py) plugs into dispatch. Also cover the RPC services in odoo/service.

pages.title: Security Model
pages.purpose: Document users and groups (res_users.py, res_groups.py, res_groups_privilege.py), model access via ir_access.py (the 19.4+ replacement for ir.model.access), record rules, field-level groups, sudo semantics, multi-company isolation, safe_eval in odoo/tools/safe_eval, and process sandboxing in setup/sandboxing. Reference the conventions in skills/odoo-security.

pages.title: Base Module and Technical Models
pages.purpose: Document odoo/addons/base: the ir.* technical models (ir_model, ir_ui_menu, ir_actions, ir_cron, ir_attachment, ir_config_parameter, ir_sequence, ir_default, ir_filters, ir_mail_server, ir_autovacuum, ir_profile) and core res.* models (res_partner, res_company, res_currency, res_country, res_lang, res_config settings).

pages.title: Views, QWeb and Reports
pages.purpose: Document server-side view architecture in ir_ui_view.py (view types, inheritance via xpath in odoo/tools/template_inheritance.py, view validation in view_validation.py), the QWeb engine in ir_qweb.py and ir_qweb_fields.py, PDF reporting in ir_actions_report.py with base_report_wkhtmltox and base_report_paper_muncher, and translations in odoo/tools/translate.py.

pages.title: Asset Bundles and JS Module System
pages.purpose: Document asset declaration in manifests and ir_asset.py, bundle compilation in odoo/addons/base/models/assetsbundle.py (SCSS, JS, XML templates, sourcemaps via odoo/tools/sourcemap_generator.py), the ES module transpiler in odoo/tools/js_transpiler.py, and the browser-side loader in addons/web/static/src/module_loader.js.

pages.title: Web Client Framework
pages.purpose: Overview of the Owl-based web client in addons/web/static/src: boot sequence (start.js, main.js, env.js, session.js), the webclient shell, action manager, and how server-side views/actions are rendered client-side. Cover the Owl 2 to Owl 3 migration and the compatibility layer in static/src/owl2.

pages.title: Core Services, Registries and Components
pages.purpose: Document addons/web/static/src/core: the registry system (registry.js), service definitions (services.js, orm, rpc/network, notification, dialog, hotkeys, ui, user, field_service, name_service), reusable components (dropdown, autocomplete, datetime, domain_selector, popover, tree_editor), py_js expression evaluation, and l10n.

pages.title: Client Views and Relational Model
pages.purpose: Document addons/web/static/src/views (form, list, kanban, calendar, graph, pivot, card, view_compiler.js, fields/ widgets) and the data layer in static/src/model (model.js, record.js, relational_model/) including how onchange, save and x2many editing round-trip to the server. Include web_hierarchy.

pages.title: Search, Actions and Frontend Interactions
pages.purpose: Document addons/web/static/src/search (control panel, search model, filters, group-bys, favorites), the action service and client actions under webclient/, public/frontend interactions in static/src/public used by website/portal, and guided tours in web_tour. Reference skills/odoo-web-guidelines for conventions.

pages.title: HTML Editor and Website Builder
pages.purpose: Document the plugin-based rich text editor in addons/html_editor and the drag-and-drop builder in addons/html_builder, how website uses them for in-page editing, and how HTML fields are sanitized and stored (odoo/tools/mail.py html_sanitize).

pages.title: Spreadsheet and Dashboards
pages.purpose: Document addons/spreadsheet (the o-spreadsheet integration, data sources bound to ORM models, pivot/list/chart functions) and the spreadsheet_dashboard family that ships per-app dashboards.

pages.title: Messaging, Discuss and Bus
pages.purpose: Document addons/mail (mail.thread and mail.activity.mixin, chatter, followers, mail templates, outgoing/incoming mail gateway, tracking), addons/bus (longpolling/websocket notifications via bus.bus and the websocket worker), Discuss channels, im_livechat, and mail_bot.

pages.title: Accounting and Invoicing
pages.purpose: Document addons/account: journals, account.move/account.move.line, taxes and tax computation, reconciliation, payments (account_payment), fiscal positions, chart of accounts templates, and electronic invoicing (account_edi, account_edi_ubl_cii, account_peppol, account_edi_proxy_client).

pages.title: Localizations
pages.purpose: Document the l10n_* module family (~229 modules): how a country module provides a chart template, taxes, fiscal positions and legal reports on top of account; country-specific EDI/e-invoicing (e.g. l10n_in_edi, l10n_fr_pdp, l10n_fr_facturx_chorus_pro); and localization bridges into POS, HR and stock. Use a few representative countries (l10n_fr, l10n_in, l10n_be, l10n_us) as worked examples.

pages.title: Sales, CRM and Loyalty
pages.purpose: Document crm (leads, opportunities, pipeline, sales_team), sale and sale_management (quotations, sale orders, order lines, invoicing policy), product configuration (product, product variants, sale_product_matrix), and loyalty/coupons (loyalty, sale_loyalty). Explain how sale_* bridge modules connect sales to stock, project, purchase and timesheets.

pages.title: Inventory, Purchase and Manufacturing
pages.purpose: Document stock (warehouses, locations, stock.picking, stock.move/stock.move.line, routes and rules, procurement, valuation in stock_account, landed costs, delivery carriers), purchase (RFQs, vendor bills, purchase_stock), and mrp (BoMs, manufacturing orders, work orders, subcontracting, repair).

pages.title: Point of Sale
pages.purpose: Document addons/point_of_sale: the standalone Owl POS frontend and its offline-capable data layer, sessions and order sync to the backend, payment terminal integrations (pos_adyen, pos_stripe, pos_viva_com, etc.), pos_restaurant, pos_self_order kiosk/mobile ordering, and IoT box support (setup/iot_box_builder).

pages.title: Website, eCommerce and Portal
pages.purpose: Document addons/website (multi-website, pages, menus, themes, SEO, website controllers), website_sale (shop, cart, checkout), portal (customer portal access and documents), and the major website_* families (blog, forum, slides/eLearning, events). Show how website routes extend the HTTP layer and QWeb.

pages.title: Payment Providers
pages.purpose: Document the payment framework in addons/payment (payment.provider, payment.transaction, payment.token, payment methods, the checkout form and webhook flow) and how payment_* modules (stripe, adyen, paypal, mollie, razorpay, etc.) implement provider-specific hooks.

pages.title: HR and Project Management
pages.purpose: Document hr (employees, departments, contracts, work entries), hr_holidays, hr_attendance, hr_expense, hr_recruitment, hr_skills, resource calendars, project and project tasks, hr_timesheet, and sale_timesheet billing.

pages.title: Testing Framework
pages.purpose: Document the Python test framework in odoo/tests (case.py: TransactionCase, HttpCase, SavepointCase semantics; form.py Form emulator; tag_selector.py and --test-tags; loader.py), the test_* addons in odoo/addons and addons/, browser tours via web_tour, and JS unit tests with Hoot (addons/web/static/lib/hoot, addons/web/static/tests, mock_server). Explain how to run each kind of test.
